## Category
<!-- Select at least one category matching the PR label: -->
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `ui`: Non-boxy UI enhancement / styling
- [ ] `slip-trap`: Curated exam trap & antidote
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `chore`: Build / dependency maintenance

## Design & Code Standards
- [ ] **Zero Emojis:** Confirmed no emojis exist in UI copy, labels, or error messages.
- [ ] **Non-Boxy Alignment:** New UI adheres to the Swiss architectural/datum guideline.
- [ ] **Modular Code:** Separation of models, providers, services, and widgets preserved.

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes locally with zero errors.
- [ ] `flutter test` executes with all tests passing.
- [ ] Verified manually on mobile device or emulator.
